aggregation.note: MEAN, not sum. Sum makes more picks = bigger polygon, which rebuilds the scoreboard the spectrum was removed for. Mean makes shape = character. Surface pick COUNT separately (polygon opacity / fill density), never as radius.
aggregation.axisOrderNote: FIXED. Radar silhouettes change dramatically with spoke order on identical data. Never sort spokes by value.
aggregation.scoring: Never rank participants by enclosed area. Perceived area scales with r^2, so area is a misleading and un-authored metric.

axes.label: Intimacy
axes.desc: How close to the body the coupling sits.

axes.label: Agency Loss
axes.desc: Who dispatches whom. High means it dispatches you.

axes.label: Visibility
axes.desc: Whether others can see the coupling.

axes.label: Consent Gap
axes.desc: How little choice you had. High means none.

axes.label: Mastery
axes.desc: Whether you can operate, fix, modify, own it.

components.label: Corrective lenses
components.blurb: The oldest mass-market body mod. Nobody calls you a cyborg for it. That's the point.

components.label: Smartwatch / fitness band
components.blurb: A sensor strapped to the wrist that tells you how you slept. You believe it over yourself.

components.label: Pacemaker / implant
components.blurb: Firmware inside the chest cavity. Heartbeat as a scheduled task.

components.label: Prosthetic limb
components.blurb: Body schema extends to fit the tool. The tool becomes body. Merleau-Ponty was early.

components.label: Daily medication
components.blurb: Chemistry-as-config. A dosage is a setting you don't get to hot-reload.

components.label: Shoes
components.blurb: Interface between foot and planet. Highly optimised, rarely considered.

components.label: Fillings / crowns / braces
components.blurb: Ceramic and metal, permanently installed in the skull. You stopped noticing on day three.

components.label: Hormonal contraception / IUD
components.blurb: An endocrine system running a patch. Invisible, elective, and politically contested.

components.label: Vaccination
components.blurb: Your immune system was handed a threat signature it never encountered. Recorded in a state registry.

components.label: Caffeine / daily stimulant
components.blurb: A psychoactive dependency so normalised it has its own furniture. Skip a day, meet the baseline.

components.label: CPAP / sleep apnea machine
components.blurb: A machine breathes with you all night and files a compliance report your insurer can read.

components.label: Insulin pump / CGM
components.blurb: A closed loop keeping you alive. The DIY community jailbroke it because the vendor wouldn't ship.

components.label: Glasses (worn daily)
components.blurb: Vision is a rendering pipeline. You patched it.

components.label: Hearing aid / earbuds
components.blurb: Audio in, audio processed, audio out. The ear now has a DSP stage.

components.label: Phone camera as memory
components.blurb: You photograph the parking spot so you don't have to remember it. Memory offloaded to sensor.

components.label: GPS / maps
components.blurb: A satellite constellation tells you where you are. You've stopped checking.

components.label: Haptic notifications
components.blurb: A new sense: the buzz. It has no name in any pre-2007 language.

components.label: Dark mode / blue light filter
components.blurb: You tuned the colour temperature of reality between 21:00 and 07:00.

components.label: Noise cancelling
components.blurb: You subtract the city with a button. Selective deafness, sold as focus.

components.label: Video doorbell / home camera
components.blurb: You extended your perimeter vision and deputised it to the police department.

components.label: LLM assistant
components.blurb: A second cortex you rent. Draft-thinking outsourced; judgement hopefully not.

components.label: Web search
components.blurb: Transactive memory with a datacenter. You don't know it, you know where it is.

components.label: Notes app / second brain
components.blurb: An external hippocampus, tagged and searchable. Recall is now grep.

components.label: Calendar
components.blurb: Your sense of time is a shared .ics file. Miss the sync, miss the meeting.

components.label: Autocorrect / predictive text
components.blurb: A model finishes your sentences. Sometimes it's right. Sometimes it's ducking wrong.

components.label: Alarm clock
components.blurb: Circadian rhythm overridden by cron. The first automation most humans install.

components.label: Machine translation
components.blurb: A model stands between you and a stranger, and you both agree to trust it.

components.label: Recommendation engine
components.blurb: Taste, precomputed. You think you chose it. The ranking chose it and let you feel authorship.

components.label: Password manager
components.blurb: Your entire identity behind one string you also can't remember. Single point of self.

components.label: A natural language
components.blurb: Language IS technology. You were compiled into one before you could consent.

components.label: A dialect / code-switching
components.blurb: Runtime selection of protocol based on who's listening. Dialect is a driver.

components.label: A programming language
components.blurb: You speak to machines in a grammar with no irregular verbs. It changed how you think.

components.label: Keyboard (touch-typing)
components.blurb: Thought exits through ten fingers at 80wpm. The keyboard has vanished from awareness.

components.label: Emoji / reactions
components.blurb: A pictographic layer bolted onto text. Tone, finally, has a codepoint.

components.label: Voice-to-text / dictation
components.blurb: Speech transcribed by a model, edited by a thumb. Two systems, one utterance.

components.label: Sign language
components.blurb: A full language running on hands and face. Suppressed by institutions for a century, and it survived.

components.label: Bicycle
components.blurb: The most efficient human-machine coupling ever shipped. Balance is done by the body-bike system.

components.label: Car
components.blurb: A two-tonne exoskeleton. You say 'I' when you mean 'the car'. ('Someone hit me.')

components.label: Public transit
components.blurb: Shared exoskeleton, timetable-driven. Assemblage at city scale.

components.label: Airplane (as passenger)
components.blurb: Pressurised tube, 11km up. You watched a film and forgot you were a payload.

components.label: Exoskeleton / powered mobility
components.blurb: Motors in the loop with your muscles. Closer to VADER than you'd like to admit.

components.label: E-bike / e-scooter
components.blurb: Battery-assisted legs. The hill is now a UI detail.

components.label: Elevator / escalator
components.blurb: Vertical transit you never chose, cannot inspect, and organise entire cities around.

components.label: Wheelchair
components.blurb: The chair is not the limitation. The stairs are. Users are expert mechanics of their own mobility.

components.label: Messaging app
components.blurb: Your relationships have a transport layer. It has read receipts.

components.label: Social feed
components.blurb: An algorithm curates what you see of other humans. Steward it or be stewarded.

components.label: Contactless payments
components.blurb: Value transfers by proximity. Money became a gesture.

components.label: Digital ID / passport chip
components.blurb: Who you are, as far as the state is concerned, is an NFC read.

components.label: Shared calendars / invites
components.blurb: Other people can write to your time. Negotiate the permissions.

components.label: Dating app
components.blurb: Intimacy, ranked and rate-limited. The matching function is a trade secret.

components.label: Ratings / star scores
components.blurb: You are scored by strangers and the score precedes you into every room.

components.label: Credit score
components.blurb: A number you never applied for decides where you may live. Nobody will show you the model.

components.label: Figma / design tool
components.blurb: Your visual thinking lives in someone else's multiplayer canvas. Cmd+Z is part of your hand.

components.label: Pen & notebook
components.blurb: Ancient write-head. Still the lowest-latency thought interface available.

components.label: Terminal / shell
components.blurb: Text in, consequences out. The most honest interface: it tells you exactly what it did.

components.label: DAW / synth
components.blurb: Time-domain editing of sound. Undo for music. Bach didn't have that.

components.label: Guitar / instrument
components.blurb: Wood and wire that disappears when played. Peak transparent tool.

components.label: Camera (as craft)
components.blurb: Framing is a cognitive act performed through glass. You see differently with it on you.

components.label: Spreadsheet
components.blurb: The most consequential programming environment on earth, operated almost entirely by non-programmers.

components.label: Sewing machine / hand tools
components.blurb: Fully ownable, fully repairable, reports to nobody. The control case for everything else here.

components.label: Generative image tools
components.blurb: You describe, it renders, and authorship becomes a question rather than a fact.

components.label: Access badge / keycard
components.blurb: A door decides whether you exist here, and logs the question either way.

components.label: Workplace chat
components.blurb: Presence as a green dot. Availability became a rendered UI state your manager can read.

components.label: Time tracking / timesheet
components.blurb: Your hours are a data structure someone else validates.

components.label: Work email
components.blurb: An inbox that assigns you tasks. You did not agree to the queue discipline.

components.label: Managed device / MDM / VPN
components.blurb: Your employer holds root on a machine you carry in your pocket to dinner.

components.label: Algorithmic dispatch / shift scheduler
components.blurb: The route, the pace, and the shift arrive from a model. Peak dispatch. No appeal path.

components.label: Smart thermostat
components.blurb: The utility can raise your temperature remotely on a demand-response event. You agreed in a rebate form.

components.label: Smart speaker / voice assistant
components.blurb: A microphone you paid for, installed yourself, and named.

components.label: Washing machine
components.blurb: Arguably the most liberating machine of the twentieth century. It gave back a day a week.

components.label: Refrigerator
components.blurb: A continuously-powered cold pocket without which your diet collapses to what is in season.

components.label: Mains electricity
components.blurb: The substrate every other item here runs on. Invisible until the grid drops.

components.label: Home broadband / wifi
components.blurb: Your dwelling has a nervous system, and it is rented from a monopoly.

ghosts.label: Clynes & Kline's rat
ghosts.note: The osmotic-pump rat from the paper that coined 'cyborg'. Total consent gap, zero mastery. The word was born describing something done TO a body.

ghosts.label: Mercury-era astronaut
ghosts.note: Clynes & Kline's actual proposal was to modify the human so the capsule could be simpler. NASA built the capsule instead. Attribute the framing, don't assert intent.

ghosts.label: Darth Vader
ghosts.note: Maximum visibility and intimacy, but note the LOW surveillance and mid agency-loss. Fiction's cyborg is conspicuous and self-directed. Ours is invisible and dispatched. That inversion is the talk.

ghosts.label: Farmer, 1890
ghosts.note: The control case. Deeply coupled to tools and animals, near-total mastery over all of them, legible to nobody. Not less cyborg — differently shaped.

ghosts.label: This room (live)
ghosts.note: Computed at runtime from the audience mean. Never hardcode.
